THE LOST STREET

A 3D exploration mystery

The whole street appeared out of nowhere in another dimension: the forest surrounds it, the houses are empty and no one is left… except one frightened neighbor. Explore the 5 houses (ground floor, upstairs, basement and garage), find the 3 letters left behind by the vanished, and discover how to set everything back to normal.
🖥️ Computer: arrow keys or WASD to move, mouse to look, SPACE to open/use — and to JUMP when there's nothing to use.
📱 Phone: joystick to move, drag to look, ACTION button to interact, JUMP button to jump.
